text:
Alex S: FYI customer IgniteAI reporting spike of 502s / timeouts on hosted inference since 15:02 UTC. They saw ~30% failed requests, latency > 8s for many calls. sample req-id: req_8b2d1f4a
Maya L: ugh, saw a few similar escalations in the queue. they included a sample error: \"upstream error: memcached/redis backend returned NOAUTH / connection refused -> gateway 502\"
Alex S: attaching customer curl they ran:
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -H "x-request-id: req_8b2d1f4a" \
  -d '{"model":"rwx-large", "prompt":"hello"}'
```
Alex S: Response body had: `\{"error\": \"upstream_kv_error: kv prefix noauth -> fallback to origin timed out\"}`
Priya K: quick check: our infra alerts show redis-prefix pool 2/6 nodes returning -NOAUTH at 15:01:40 UTC, connection errors, then surge in request latency due to fallback to disk DB. looks correlated with secret rotation job that ran at 15:00.
Tom R: oh — we rotated redis TLS certs + vault token refresh earlier. Did the secret sync job push the new password to the prefix service?
Priya K: logs from kv-prefix worker (excerpt):
```
ERRO [2026-06-12T15:01:42Z] kv-prefix: redis error on write: NOAUTH Authentication required
WARN [2026-06-12T15:01:44Z] kv-prefix: falling back to datastore get (slower path)
ERR  [2026-06-12T15:02:01Z] gateway: upstream timed out after 6s -> returning 502
```
Maya L: customer says they started a run at 15:03 and ~40% of tokens failed mid-generation. very visible, they hit error budgets.
Alex S: status page currently shows partial degradation for hosted API in us-west-2? Not updated. Can we confirm scope and customer impact?
Priya K: scope: us-west-2 prefix cache cluster only. approx 12% of total host traffic routed there; impacted ~1200 requests/min during spike. affected services: hosted inference API + some embeddings routes that use prefix caching.
Tom R: immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback secret rotation (if safe) 2) push the correct redis auth token from Vault to kv-prefix config 3) route traffic away from prefix cache pool to healthy replica (need routing config change) 4) increase gateway upstream timeouts temporarily so clients get longer waits instead of immediate 502s.
Priya K: tried `vault read secret/redis/prefix` — new token present. but kv-prefix instances still using old token. looks like the sync job failed on the prefix fleet. sync job logs show 403 when trying to write to instance metadata at 15:00:35, likely RBAC change.
Tom R: can someone run this on control-plane to force sync?
Maya L: I can trigger the sync, but want approval to restart kv-prefix pods if needed.
Alex S: customer wants frequent updates. I'll tell them we're triaging and will push updates every 10m.
Priya K: quick repro steps for eng: 
1) curl health endpoint on a failed prefix node: `curl -s http://kv-prefix-03.us-west-2.internal/health` -> will show `redis_auth: false`
2) run `redis-cli -h redis-prefix-03.auth.usw2 -a <new-token> ping` -> should return PONG if token synced
3) check vault sync logs: `kubectl -n infra logs vault-sync-2026-06-12` -> look for 403s
Tom R: I pushed a manual secret update to kv-prefix-03 and restarted the pod. it came back healthy and started serving cached hits. early telemetry shows error % dropping from 32% -> 6% for that AZ.
Priya K: rolling update plan: run sync fix + restart on remaining 5 nodes in a staggered fashion, 1 node at a time, monitor error rate. timeline ~30-45m.
deploy-bot: scheduled restart of kv-prefix pods (kv-prefix-01 -> kv-prefix-06) with 5m stagger by Priya K
Maya L: customer update: \"thanks, some traffic looks better, still seeing tail latency but we can continue\". asked for ETA for full fix.
Alex S: ETA sent to customer: 45m for full roll. will keep posting every 10m.
Tom R: postmortem notes to collect: - why sync job hit 403 (RBAC change?) - add canary that validates secret propagation pre-rotation - make kv-prefix gracefully fail open with cached TTLs instead of immediate NOAUTH fallback to origin - consider a temporary read-only fallback to in-memory cache if auth fails
Priya K: I'm adding alert rules: if >5% of prefix nodes report NOAUTH -> page oncall eng-infra immediately, and mute non-actionable noise.
Maya L: any billing/customer concerns? they asked whether ops SLA credits apply. Alex, can you open a billing case?
Alex S: already opened ticket with billing. ticket# BILL-20260612-99. copying customer billing contact.
Tom R: after restart finished across all nodes, final numbers: error rate down to 0.8%, p95 latency back to normal. will follow up with a short RCA draft in incidents channel.
Alex S: thanks everyone. I'll post final update in 30m and mark this thread resolved when RCA posted. :thumbsup:
